state:
Goal `core-time-and-1-more`: every `Core\Time` member has all its feature proofs, and `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Time'` and `--group 'Core\Cldr'` both print "nothing owed". The `Core\Cldr` and `Core\Time` figures were re-measured after `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/cldr.rs` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs` changed.
`now`'s attack found that `Core\Time\Instant::plus` and `minus` past the timestamp range threw jiff's own sentence. Both now throw `PAST_THE_RANGE`, the sentence `at`, `fromIso` and `parse` use, pinned by `tests/conformance/core/time-instant-plus-and-minus-name-the-range-past-either-end.nvst`.
`Core\Time\Date` has its class card (`DATE_CARD`), so the stage's last check, `proofs: Core\Time\Date`, owes only `minus`, `with` and `compareTo`: examples, an attack, a bench each, and `.nvst` cases (`with` and `compareTo` 0 of 2, `minus` 1 of 2).
Any `time.rs` edit stales every `Core\Time` figure, so the session that closes the stage re-runs `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Time'` and `--group 'Core\Time\Date'` after its last edit.

next.title: the dossier, `Core\Time\Date`'s three members
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs` (the `DATE` rows and their bodies), plus each member's own proof directories under `docs/examples/core/Time-Date/`, `tests/hostile/core/Time-Date/` and `benches/members/core/Time-Date/`.

items.text: **`Core\Time\Date::minus`** — owes examples, hostile, perf and one more `.nvst` case (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Row in `DATE` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2473`, body at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:4681`. An instance member needs a `// covers: Core\Time\Date::minus` marker on its cases.

**`Core\Time\Date::with`** — owes the same, and 2 `.nvst` cases. Body at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:4693`; its `year`/`nanos` refusals still pass jiff's `err.to_string()` for some failures, so an attack there may find the same bug `Instant::plus` had — use `PAST_THE_RANGE`'s shape for the fix.
**`Core\Time\Date::compareTo`** — owes the same, and 2 `.nvst` cases. Body at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:4724`. Then re-record `--group 'Core\Time'` and `--group 'Core\Time\Date'`.

backlog: Many `Core\Time\DateTime` members still pass jiff's `err.to_string()` to `out_of_range` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`, the `DateTime::{member}` sites); the goal that proves `DateTime` will meet them in its attacks.
